title: Venaticulinaries
description: This mod adds new food variants like Schnitzel, Brezels and more (mostly German food)
body:
This mod adds a variety of (mostly German) food items to Minecraft, including Schnitzel, Doughnuts (Krapfen), Bretzels, and more. 
The goal of the mod is to bring traditional German cuisine into the game, giving players new items to cook and use for role‑play or survival gameplay.

Current features include:
- Several new craftable food items
- Recipes balanced for survival mode (so nothing too overpowered)
- Item textures designed to fit naturally into vanilla gameplay

More foods and recipes will be added over time, and I plan to support both newer and older Minecraft versions as the mod progresses.


**Questions:**
> Q: Will there be a Forge port?
 
> A: Probably not for now, but maybe in the future since I only recently started making mods.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
> Q: Will there be newer Version support
 
> A: Yes, most likely once the mod leaves its beta state. I will then focus on supporting some of the newest versions.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
> Q: Can you add my food suggestion?
 
> A: Sure! As long as it’s something appropriate (no illegal or harmful items).

If you have more questions, feel free to ask in the comments!

Made with love by Venaticshelf408
